title: Where ReviewHog model pins live and what must change with them
answers: Where are ReviewHog model ids pinned?
What files need updating when changing the ReviewHog reviewer or validator model?
Which test asserts the review model in analytics events?
body:
Pins are all in products/review_hog/backend/reviewer/constants.py: REVIEW_MODEL, FLASH_ARM.model, VALIDATION_MODEL, RESOLUTION_MODEL, OUTCOME_JUDGE_MODEL (resolution and judge mirror the validator's model by convention).
Change together with them:
- products/review_hog/ARCHITECTURE.md (names the ids for reviewer, validator/resolver, FLASH_ARM, and the effort-application line).
- docs/internal/sandboxes-setup-guide.md (Flash model id).
- Hardcoded expectation in products/review_hog/backend/tests/test_review_completed_tracking.py (`review_model` in test_events_carry_the_tier_and_report_link_of_an_agent_pr).
DECISIONS.md is intentionally not edited: it is the history of each pin, not the current reference.
applies: Model-id bumps for ReviewHog reviewer, Flash, validator, resolver, outcome judge.
